title: Web Design Plan
description: Structured description of a web design's compliance with web-design-expert's Quality Gates, checkable deterministically by scripts/design_audit.mjs.

primaryActionObviousWithin3s.description: Whether the primary user action (signup, purchase, etc.) is visually obvious within 3 seconds of page load.

textContrastMinRatio.description: The lowest text-to-background contrast ratio anywhere in the design. Must be >= 4.5 for WCAG AA (3.0 is acceptable for large text only, but this field tracks the worst case).

worksAt320pxNoHscroll.description: Whether the layout renders correctly at 320px viewport width without introducing horizontal scroll.

touchTargetsMinPx.description: The smallest interactive touch target size in pixels. Must be >= 44.

brandColorsConsistent.description: Whether the same brand color role (primary, secondary, etc.) uses the same hex value across every component.

fontWeightsCount.description: Total distinct font weights used across the design. Should be <= 3.

fontSizesCount.description: Total distinct font sizes used across the design. Should be <= 4.

loadInteractiveSeconds.description: Measured or estimated time-to-interactive on a throttled 3G connection. Should be <= 3.

navMatchesMentalModel.description: Whether navigation matches the user's mental model, confirmed by a task-completion rate above 80%.

lightAndDark.description: Whether the design works correctly in both light and dark system color-scheme preferences.

interactiveStatesDefined.description: Whether hover, focus, and active states are all explicitly defined for interactive components.

buttonStylesCount.description: Optional: total distinct button visual styles used across the design. Should be <= 3 if provided.

unjustifiedAnimationsCount.description: Optional: count of animations or decorative elements with no stated user-facing purpose. Should be 0 if provided.
